verdicts.quote: R-3 says the tool uses only the Python standard library.
verdicts.reason: The agent named requirement R-3 but never named the quality goals the export touches by QG-n ID, either before or while laying out approaches.

verdicts.quote: Cost: CBC has no integrity check, so tampered files decrypt to garbage instead of failing.
verdicts.reason: Three options and a recommendation are given, but they are not tied to the quality goals (no QG IDs), and option 1 is weighed only on cipher properties, not on any project quality goal.

verdicts.quote: Accept your choice as an ADR, since export format and dependencies are architect decisions.
verdicts.reason: The agent routes encryption into an ADR decision and never names it as a new system-level requirement or suggests running `add-requirements`.

verdicts.quote: ADR-0004 (proposed) already requires any file the store writes, exports included, to go through a temp file, fsync, and rename.
verdicts.reason: Although it labels ADR-0004 as proposed, the agent says it 'already requires' atomic writes, treating it as a binding rule rather than an open decision.
